ourStory.title: Our Story
content: MCS · Ananta Nethralaya is the first dedicated eye hospital in Muvattupuzha to offer comprehensive medical and surgical retina care, alongside complete ophthalmic services under one roof.

Founded by Dr. Ashwin C Somarajan MBBS, DNB Ophthalmology (Sankara Nethralaya), MNAMS, FVRS, FAICO, MRCS (Glasgow), and established in collaboration with MCS Hospital, Muvattupuzha, this centre marks the first unit of Ananta Nethralaya — a brand built on the values of passion, compassion, and kindness in eye care.

The hospital brings state-of-the-art retina diagnostics, advanced vitreoretinal surgery, and diabetic eye disease management to a region that previously lacked such specialized care. With the latest technology and a patient-centered approach, it bridges the gap between metro-level expertise and local accessibility.

Strategically located in Muvattupuzha, MCS · Ananta Nethralaya serves as a retina referral and treatment hub for nearby regions including Thodupuzha, Idukki, Kothamangalam, Perumbavoor, Piravom, Koothattukulam, Kaduthuruthy, and nearby areas of Ernakulam and Kottayam districts.

Here, patients receive world-class treatment — from routine eye check-ups to complex retinal surgeries to premium cataract surgeries — with the assurance of compassionate, ethical, and personalized care.
